findings.evidence: `Galois/Basic.lean:177` proves generic `isGalois`, and lines 221–228 define generic `aut_commute`; the specialized proof at lines 143–151 instead uses `candidateGenusFieldGaloisGroupEquiv`, whose construction additionally requires prime-discriminant independence.
findings.fix: First package a field-generic `IsAbelianGalois K (adjoin K (Set.range root))` theorem from `isGalois hroot` and `aut_commute hroot` in `Galois/Basic.lean`, then transport that result to `candidateGenusField`.
findings.issue: `isAbelianGalois_candidateGenusField` reproves commutativity through the specialized sign-pattern equivalence, although every finite multiquadratic extension is already generically Galois and abelian without independence.

summary: The abelian-Galois result is packaged only for the candidate genus field despite existing field-generic proofs requiring no square-class independence.
